text:
```yaml
name: Replace [new] with [[alloc] init] in ObjC

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  replace-new:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Find and replace [new] with [[alloc] init]
        id: replace
        uses: jacobtomlinson/gha-find-replace@f1069b438f125e5395d1c6fd3b559a7880cb5
        with:
          include: '**/*.m,**/*.h,**/*.mm'
          exclude: ''
          find: "\\[([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\\s+new\\]"
          replace: "\\[\\[\\1 alloc\\] init\\]"
          regex: true

      - name: Commit changes
        if: steps.replace.outputs.modifiedFiles != ''
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          author_name: github-actions[bot]
          author_email: github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          message: "chore: replace [new] with [[alloc] init] in ObjC files"
          add: .
          push: true
          default_author: github_actor
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
